# aRTF Clothes dataset

- Source: https://zenodo.org/records/10875542
- DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.10875542
- Version: 1.0.0
- License: CC BY 4.0
- Downloaded artifact: `aRTFClothes-resized-paper-splits.zip`
- Official size: 309381398 bytes
- Official MD5: `1b342fb06d3112f193b935c8b0d7d768`
- Resolution: 512x256

Only the T-shirt and shorts nested archives were extracted for conversion. The towels archive remains inside the verified outer ZIP and is not used. Official train, validation and test assignments are preserved. Project mapping: `tshirt -> top (0)`, `shorts -> shorts (3)`.

The converted dataset is supplemental domain data. It does not depict dense retail shelf stacks and it does not cover all seven project classes.
